help.short: Specifies the preferred language for the response.

description: List a list of locations to which you can ship the disks associated with an import or export job. A location is a Microsoft data center region.

operations.description: Returns a list of locations to which you can ship the disks associated with an import or export job. A location is a Microsoft data center region.

params.description: Specifies the preferred language for the response.
params.name: Accept-Language

consts.description: Specifies the API version to use for this request.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Specifies the resource identifier of the location.
props.name: id

props.description: Specifies the name of the location. Use List Locations to get all supported locations.
props.name: name

props.description: Additional shipping information for customer, specific to datacenter to which customer should send their disks.
props.name: additionalShippingInformation

props.description: A list of location IDs that should be used to ship shipping drives to for jobs created against the current location. If the current location is active, it will be part of the list. If it is temporarily closed due to maintenance, this list may contain other locations.
props.name: alternateLocations

props.description: The city name to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: city

props.description: The country or region to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: countryOrRegion

props.description: The phone number for the Azure data center.
props.name: phone

props.description: The postal code to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: postalCode

props.description: The recipient name to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: recipientName

props.description: The state or province to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: stateOrProvince

props.description: The first line of the street address to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: streetAddress1

props.description: The second line of the street address to use when shipping the drives to the Azure data center.
props.name: streetAddress2

props.description: A list of carriers that are supported at this location.
props.name: supportedCarriers

props.description: Specifies the type of the location.
props.name: type
